Source square brackets are scholarly restorations; source omissions/ellipses and disagreements retained. ⟦word?⟧ marks PROJECT capture doubt, distinct from source restoration. Facsimiles control unresolved letters, dots and bracket boundaries. No readings supplied from grammar or neighboring witnesses. English panel/Exterior captions and sic annotations are editorial, not ancient text. No personal audit or release decision.
